title: Wip3out Special Edition Beta Texturepack

licence.summary: No licence stated by the author
licence.redistribution: Downloaded from the author's own link only when you choose this pack; NeoStation does not host or redistribute the files.

credits: README: textures from the official Wipeout 3 US demo (Official U.S. PlayStation Magazine #25; Psygnosis Leeds, Sony, Studio Liverpool), found and ported by Matsilagi; Concept Assegai skin by Shara; Concept Icaras skin by Matsilagi; XentaX PBP/CMP scripts and TIMViewer used to read the textures.
requirements: Made by the author for Beetle PSX HW with its Vulkan renderer, Track Textures and Replace Textures (what NeoStation's switch sets).
notes: Beta ship liveries, menu team colours, low-poly ships and power-up icons from the US demo, for the PAL Special Edition (SCES-02845). The optional skins of the alternate_textures folder are not installed (Beetle reads its folder flat).
